abschnitte.titel: Part A — the official Erbschein wizard (service.justiz.de)

texte: [EN mechanism test — not an official translation, wording may not match a future real form] These six questions are asked by the official Erbschein (certificate of inheritance) wizard, to clarify whether a certificate is needed at all. Order and wording basis: as of 27.08.2026.

bloecke.frage: What was the deceased person's nationality?
Where was their center of life (habitual residence)?
Is there a will or an inheritance contract?

texte: Note: Vivodepot does not yet have its own inheritance-contract type — an existing inheritance contract cannot be recorded in structured form here and therefore always appears as a gap, even where one actually exists.

bloecke.frage: Does the estate include real property?
bloecke.luecke: — not recorded, please check at the time of inheritance —

bloecke.frage: Does the estate include a company entered in the commercial register?
bloecke.luecke: — not recorded, please check at the time of inheritance —

bloecke.frage: Has a bank or other institution already requested a certificate of inheritance?
bloecke.luecke: — can only be answered at the time of inheritance —

abschnitte.titel: Part B — what the certificate-of-inheritance application additionally requires

texte: [EN mechanism test] This information relates to the actual application form ("erbschein/anfrage" in the a2j-rechtsantragstelle repository), which is NOT yet online on service.justiz.de — the official wording may still change before publication. What follows is Vivodepot's compilation of the underlying vault entries, not a verified official form.

Grandchildren, great-grandchildren, and the deceased's parents/ancestors are not yet modeled in structured form by Vivodepot's data model — this information remains a gap by design, regardless of how complete the vault otherwise is.

dokAusgabe.herkunftText: Vivodepot compilation from your vault entries — EN mechanism-test fixture, not an official form, no connection to service.justiz.de.
dokAusgabe.unterschriftErsatzHinweis: This extract does not replace the statutory declaration — it must still be given in person before a court or notary (§ 2356 BGB). It also does not replace the official Erbschein wizard itself.
dokAusgabe.fussText: · EN mechanism-test fixture, not an official document
